caption: A shiny DVD is tilted in sunlight, and rainbow bands slide across the wall as it turns.

sa.check: A shiny DVD is tilted in sunlight.
Rainbow bands slide across the wall as it turns.
The bands vanish when the disc is turned away or the sun is covered.

pc.expect: The bands move as the disc tilts and only then.
pc.fail: They slide with the disc still; or stay put while the disc turns; or flicker in steady sun.

pc.expect: The bands appear only while the sun hits the disc and would vanish when the disc is turned away or the sun covered.
pc.fail: They are there with no sun; or the disc is in sun with no bands; or they remain with the disc turned away.

pc.expect: The bands are rainbow-coloured and the wall stays white.
pc.fail: They are a single colour; or white; or the wall changes colour.
They are a single round spot; or sharp squares; or flood the wall.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or a band becomes solid.
The room rearranges; or the wall changes; or the disc changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
